item.title: Butterflies
item.description:
Documentaries put lighter demand on attention than cinema, but still offer plenty of surprises. So I’ve been watching mostly documentaries, but there was no real reason to mention any of them here yet. And while I’ve been skipping my cinema lately, it does not leave me and has caught up with me when I wouldn’t expect it.

Instead of cinema I’m currently on my second week of mild French prescription tranquilizers. I bet the French cinema will look even more lucid and crisply intelligent to me after the course.
